# See https://pre-commit.com for more information
# See https://pre-commit.com/hooks.html for more hooks

repos:
  - repo: local
    hooks:
      - id: verify-network-connectivity
        name: Verify network connectivity
        entry: scripts/verify_network_connectivity.sh
        language: script
        pass_filenames: false
        stages: [pre-commit]

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# Simple connectivity check for pre-commit.
# - Uses ping when available.
# - Falls back to a TCP connect via bash's /dev/tcp.

HOST="${NETWORK_CHECK_HOST:-1.1.1.1}"
COUNT="${NETWORK_CHECK_COUNT:-1}"
TIMEOUT_SEC="${NETWORK_CHECK_TIMEOUT_SEC:-2}"
PORT="${NETWORK_CHECK_PORT:-443}"

if command -v ping >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  # Linux: -W is timeout in seconds. macOS: -W is timeout in ms and -t is TTL.
  # We'll try the Linux form first; if it fails, try a portable-ish form.
  if ping -c "${COUNT}" -W "${TIMEOUT_SEC}" "${HOST}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    exit 0
  fi
  if ping -c "${COUNT}" "${HOST}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    exit 0
  fi
fi

# Fallback: try opening a TCP connection (bash only)
if [[ -e /dev/tcp/${HOST}/${PORT} ]] 2>/dev/null; then
  exit 0
fi

# If /dev/tcp is supported, this will succeed quickly; otherwise it will error.
if (exec 3<>"/dev/tcp/${HOST}/${PORT}") >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  exec 3<&-
  exec 3>&-
  exit 0
fi

echo "Network connectivity check failed (host=${HOST} port=${PORT})." >&2
exit 1

arguments.newText:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# Connectivity check for pre-commit.
#
# What it does:
# - Attempts HTTP(S) access to common internal URLs (by default: http://admin-portal.local)
# - Prints a short report (status code / error)
# - Exits non-zero if ALL targets are unreachable
#
# Customize targets by setting NETWORK_CHECK_URLS as a space-separated list.

TIMEOUT_SEC="${NETWORK_CHECK_TIMEOUT_SEC:-3}"
URLS_STR="${NETWORK_CHECK_URLS:-http://admin-portal.local}"

# shellcheck disable=SC2206
URLS=( ${URLS_STR} )

have_curl=false
have_wget=false
command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1 && have_curl=true
command -v wget >/dev/null 2>&1 && have_wget=true

if ! $have_curl && ! $have_wget; then
  echo "verify_network_connectivity: need curl or wget installed" >&2
  exit 2
fi

ok_any=false

for url in "${URLS[@]}"; do
  if $have_curl; then
    # -f: fail on 4xx/5xx (we still want status), so don't use -f.
    # We treat any HTTP response as connectivity; record the status code.
    status="$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --max-time "$TIMEOUT_SEC" "$url" 2>/dev/null || true)"
    if [[ -n "$status" && "$status" != "000" ]]; then
      echo "[OK]   $url -> HTTP $status"
      ok_any=true
      continue
    fi
    echo "[FAIL] $url -> no HTTP response (curl)"
  else
    # wget prints errors; keep it quiet, treat successful fetch as OK.
    if wget -q -T "$TIMEOUT_SEC" -O /dev/null "$url"; then
      echo "[OK]   $url -> reachable (wget)"
      ok_any=true
    else
      echo "[FAIL] $url -> unreachable (wget)"
    fi
  fi
done

if $ok_any; then
  exit 0
fi

echo "verify_network_connectivity: all targets unreachable" >&2
exit 1

content.text:
Created/updated a local pre-commit hook that runs a script to check internal URL connectivity.

- Added `.pre-commit-config.yaml` with a `repo: local` hook:
  - `id: verify-network-connectivity`
  - `entry: scripts/verify_network_connectivity.sh`
  - `language: script`, `pass_filenames: false`

- Implemented `scripts/verify_network_connectivity.sh` to:
  - Attempt to access internal URLs (default: `http://admin-portal.local`)
  - Print a report line per URL (`[OK] ... HTTP <code>` or `[FAIL] ...`)
  - Exit non-zero only if *all* targets are unreachable
  - Allow override via `NETWORK_CHECK_URLS="http://admin-portal.local http://intranet.local"` and `NETWORK_CHECK_TIMEOUT_SEC`
